basis: Sizes of the build at commit 26f6830 plus 10%, rounded up to 100 bytes, for the JS, CSS and GLBs the app ships. The wasm, its loader and the model are pinned by SHA-256 in frontend/scripts/vendor-mediapipe.mjs, so their budget is the exact size, as a minimum and a maximum. Each class also names how many files it has, so an extra chunk, a .mjs chunk or a missing file fails even when its size fits. A script outside these classes fails the otherJs budget.

pageLoad.basis: Lab numbers, not field data: median of five cold loads in Chromium 159 with a 4x CPU slowdown and a 9 Mbit/s, 40 ms link. Measured on an Apple M4 Pro (run page-load in results.json) and in an emulated x86 Linux container with 2 CPUs: catalogue LCP 544 and 552 ms, try-on LCP 604 and 624 ms, CLS 0.030 and 0.028 on the try-on and 0 on the catalogue, TBT 0 ms. The budgets sit under the web.dev good thresholds (LCP 2500 ms, CLS 0.1, TBT 200 ms) with at least twice the measured LCP and three times the measured CLS, so a slower runner does not fail a build and a regression of that size does.
